title: Fresh 5-Repo Config Sweep

repositories.name: vite
repositories.notes: Frontend tooling repo with package, CI, TypeScript, and workspace configuration.

repositories.name: react
repositories.notes: Large JavaScript monorepo with fixture and package metadata coverage.

repositories.name: ansible
repositories.notes: Automation project with substantial YAML and CI configuration.

repositories.name: grafana
repositories.notes: Observability app with Go, Node, CI, and deployment-oriented configuration.

repositories.name: deno
repositories.notes: Runtime repo with TypeScript, JSON, workflow, and tooling configuration.

findings: React produced no file issues; only catalog schema-unavailable warnings for the known Vercel draft-04 incompatibility and a CircleCI schema metaschema problem.
Ansible produced 711 issues, mostly SchemaStore Ansible task/playbook/meta validation noise in integration test fixtures; the 32 parse failures were deliberately malformed JSON/YAML fixture files.

Grafana produced 175 issues: 8 deliberately broken/empty testdata parse failures, 31 missing local schema loads for uninstalled Nx/Lerna node_modules schemas because dependency prep was not run, and many validation issues from Docker Compose fragments and Grafana plugin/OpenAPI fixtures that are not standalone catalog documents.
Deno produced 43 issues, mostly empty/malformed test fixture JSON/YAML and tsconfig/package/jsr validation mismatches in intentionally unusual compatibility fixtures.
Vite produced 6 issues from empty or malformed test fixtures plus package/pnpm workspace fixture validation mismatches.
No crashes, hangs, unexplained warnings, output-contract regressions, or unclassified skipped-file problems appeared in this sweep.
productDecisions: Keep reporting intentionally malformed fixture files and partial config fragments in full-repository sweeps; these are useful signals but should be handled by project config/exclusions rather than hidden globally.
Consider improving schema issue hints for missing local file:// schemas so users can tell that dependencies such as node_modules were not installed before validation.
The repeated Ansible task-schema noise suggests full-repository sweeps may benefit from clearer branch-error grouping or docs guidance for test fixture directories, not a parser fix.
The recurring Vercel catalog schema warning remains a third-party schema compatibility signal already recorded in prior sweeps; CircleCI schema metaschema failure should be watched if it recurs.
followUp: No product code changes were made during this sweep.
Structured result recorded in split reports/real-world-results storage.
Updated the real-world testing skill after this sweep to require context-sensitive dependency prep before validation when dependencies affect schema/config fidelity.

dependencyPrep.notes: This sweep used raw shallow clones and did not install target-repo dependencies before validation; missing local node_modules schemas were interpreted as dependency-prep limitations rather than target-repo invalidity.
